**v1.7.0: the battle simulator deals your deck the way the game does and casts it the way the bot does.**
- **Treasure cards.** The game deals only your main deck, so the simulator does too. Treasure cards come into a battle only the way the bot draws them: with `drawenchant` on (off by default), when an enchant would make a kill. A treasure card the bot drew this round isn't played till the next round, unless it's an enchant. Before, the simulator shuffled treasure cards into the cards it dealt, so decks with treasure cards looked better than they play.
- **Blades and traps.** With `reboost` off (the default), the bot casts each blade and trap once a battle. A used copy stays in your hand until a Reshuffle lets it go again. The simulator now does the same. With `reboost` on, a blade or trap goes again after the hit that used it. Before, the simulator cast a blade again as soon as the last one was used.
- **Your settings reach it.** "Can this deck beat it", the planner and the zone deck (`deckzone`) now get every setting the simulator plays by: `reboost`, `drawenchant`, `drawneed`, `drawround`, `drawmax`, `enemyspells` (off: no defending) and `useabsorb`. Before, the zone deck got none of your settings. It now plays each deck with the deck profile the bot would put on with it. When drawing is off for the run (Draw ended the turn, or Draw was greyed out in the last 30 minutes), all three know.
- **The planner** knows which blades and traps the bot has already cast this battle and how many treasure cards it has drawn, so it doesn't suggest a card the bot won't cast again. In a party, a blader's or healer's blades, traps and Tower Shield come back after the hitter's hit, the way Party.ahk casts them.
- **Your boss deck may change.** Decks with treasure cards, or with two or more copies of a blade or trap, now win less often in the simulator, because that's how the bot plays them. "No deck for bosses is likely to beat it" will show more often. Measured on the same dice (400 battles each):
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap against a 6000-health boss: 99.8% won before, 59.5% now (it runs out of cards 40% of the time). Against 3 mobs: 93% before, 22.5% now.
  - 4 Storm Lord + 10 Thunder Snake + 3 Stormblade with 6 treasure Monstrous, against an Ogre and an Imp: 36% before, 3% now.
  - A deck with one copy of each blade and trap, no treasure cards and no Reshuffle: exactly the same as before (with a Reshuffle, within about a point).
- **Worth knowing.** The bot itself plays decks with many copies of one blade or trap badly. With `reboost` off and no Sharpen in the deck, it keeps every used copy in hand for the rest of the battle (Autofarmer.ahk DiscardSpare throws one away only once its sharpened and plain casts are both used). In the simulator, the 6+6 deck above wins 97.8% with `reboost` on, and 91.8% if the bot threw used copies away. Until that's changed, use fewer copies of each blade and trap, or switch `reboost` on. These are simulated numbers, not tried in the game yet.
- **Fixes.** A garbled deck reading no longer stops the zone deck's simulation: the bad card is left out. Junk numbers in a deck or a setting no longer stop the simulator.
- **Mixed versions are fine.** An older AutoFarmer with this helper gets the bot's default settings for the new values; this AutoFarmer with an older helper plays as before.
- **Not tried in the game yet.** The game still has to show whether Draw leaves the round to play, whether a treasure Stormblade stacks with the deck's, and whether a blade or trap can miss (TODO.md, "Not in LIVE_CHECKS yet").
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
